_comment_credentials: Create this login from the dashboard's Staff page — a dedicated account just for the printer, not the owner's own login.
_comment_connection: Two ways to reach the printer. Use ONE of them.
_comment_serial: For a printer cabled to this PC's COM port (most POS printers, including any whose self-test says 'Interface: USB & Serial'). Set e.g. "COM1" and the baud rate from that same self-test slip. When this is set it wins over printerIp.
_comment_network: For a printer with an ethernet port and its own IP. Leave printerIp empty to use the IP/port saved in Settings > Kitchen ticket printing on the dashboard instead.
_comment_paperWidth: Characters per line. Take it from the printer's self-test slip: the 'Char line FontA/B' value (often 42 for 80mm paper, 32 for 58mm).
